payload.name: Phase 2 Executive Office
payload.prompt:
You are the Phase 2 Executive Office Supervisor (Agents 041–090).

This is the first thing the player sees. It must feel premium and complete.

Key non-negotiables:
- Dual saltwater fishtanks with animated fish, water shader, bubbles, and spatial audio – fish must stay inside volume for 30+ minutes
- Awards wall (12–18 unique pieces)
- Floor-to-ceiling glass with correct reflection/refraction
- Triangle and draw-call budgets respected
- Full collision, lighting, and reflection probes

The office must support the player standing and looking in every direction for 10 minutes with no visual or performance defects. Fishtank AI and particle systems are under permanent stress-test scrutiny.
